records.source: Let AI agents use your real iPhone. With iphone-use installed on your Mac, Claude Code, Codex or any MCP client reads the phone's screen as text, taps, types and swipes in any app, including the ones with no API: Health, banking, chat apps, or the app you are testing. You can watch it live and take the phone back at any time.

baseline.text: 让AI代理使用你的真实iPhone。在你的Mac上安装了iPhone，Claude Code、Codex或任何MCP客户端会将手机屏幕读取为文本，在任何应用中点击、输入和滑动，包括那些没有API的应用：健康、银行、聊天应用或你正在测试的应用。你可以随时观看直播，并把手机拿回去。

records.source: Let AI agents use your real iPhone. With iphone-use installed on your Mac, Claude Code, Codex or any MCP client reads the phone's screen as text, taps, types and swipes in any app, including the ones with no API: Health, banking, chat apps, or the app you are testing. You can watch it live and take the phone back at any time.
